description_en: Unbinds an NLB listener from an application
description_zh: 调用UnbindNlb删除应用访问绑定的NLB监听
kebab_example: aliyun sae unbind-nlb --app-id 7171a6ca-d1cd-4928-8642-7d5cfe690000 --nlb-id nlb-7z7jjbzz44d82c9000 --protocol TCP --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindNlb

parameters.help_en:
The protocol. Valid values:

TCP

UDP

TCPSSL
parameters.help_zh:

TCP。
UDP。
TCPSSL
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The listener port, which must be between 0 and 65535
parameters.name: port
